evidence.title: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML

summary: A large-scale effort to reproduce 2,200 papers from the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) uncovered patterns in AI research reproducibility and methodological trends. The findings highlight challenges and best practices in the field.
title: Researchers Reproduce 2,200 ICML Papers, Revealing Key Insights in AI Research
